unitsPerSquare.description: Units per 1 cm square, such as 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 20, 25 or 50. For time axes, minutes per square (15, 30, 60).

origin.description: Value where the other axis crosses, default 0. A travel graph from 12 00 uses x origin 720 (minutes) with negativeSquares 0.

labelEvery.description: Number every nth 1 cm line from the origin. Omit for every line (every second line at 0.5 a square).

format.description: time reads values as minutes after midnight and prints 12 00, 12 30. Default number.

name.description: Italic letter at the arrow, such as t.

title.description: Axis title in words with its unit in brackets, such as "Distance from home (km)" or "Time of day". Replaces the italic x or y.

titleAbove.description: y only: print the title above the axis (Edexcel style), so the graph stays narrow beside a table.

format.description: time reads values as minutes after midnight and prints 12 00, 12 30. Default number.

title.description: Axis title in words with its unit in brackets, such as "Distance from home (km)" or "Time of day". Replaces the italic x or y.

titleAbove.description: y only: print the title above the axis (Edexcel style), so the graph stays narrow beside a table.

grid.description: 1cm squares (default), or a fine grid of 5mm or 2mm squares inside heavier 1 cm lines. Scales still count 1 cm squares. none draws sketch axes, as exam sketch questions print them: no grid and no axis numbers, only the axes with arrowheads, x, y and the origin (use originLabel O). Mark values on a sketch with a line's labels.

originLabel.description: The origin mark: an italic O, as Edexcel papers print it (default), or 0.
